repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `5e6e0037f55ea31c19194c458fba50b698bafb79` · 2026-11-24T23:49Z

Requested by zone a4-S (7147702004) for card #36905. Tier H by size (4,531 changed lines; ruling 7145880574): after a delta ACCEPT the seat hands it to the maintainer.

Sound as built: all six card items are delivered. Item 5: `AccessPillar` is deleted and nothing imports, routes to or links to it. Leave guards, save paths (own package and installed `.custom`), permission gates, the #36660 AI-draft rule, the #36901 item-tool tabs, the `AreaHistoryRedirect` exemption removal and the old-address redirects all check out. `PILLAR_FOR_SURFACE_TYPE`, the publish toast's "open Access" and `PILLARS` still reach `/access` through the redirect and are handed to #36909. Size breakdown: deletion dominates (2,250 lines are whole files removed); nothing is generated. Check-runs: 47 success, 15 expected skip, 0 failed — at a base that predates #37108.

M1 (must-fix) — undeclared narrowing of the published i18n pack. All 15 removed keys (the `engine.studio.access.*` set and `engine.studio.owd.railLabel`, en and zh) ship in released `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` under `./namespaces/studio` (served by `loadStudioCatalogue` / `studioString`), yet the PR says `Clause-②: no` and the changeset says no locale key changes. Fix, as on #37049: restore the 15 rows in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` and `zh.ts`, left unread. (The alternative — the full narrowing kit — is not taken on a UI card.)
M2 (must-fix) — stale against #37108 (merged, not in this base): merge-tree is clean but three of its tests on `main` fail once merged — `StudioDesignSurface.metadataArea-28561.test.tsx` ~400-422 (waits for `access-rail-set-sales_rep`, expects `/access?surface=owd%3Aoverview`) and `StudioPaletteGroups.surfaceScope-36900.test.tsx` ~302-303 and ~316 (old addresses for a permission item and the sharing overview). Merge `origin/main`, repoint them to `/metadata/permission/sales_rep?package=…` and `/studio/<pkg>/owd`, re-run the palette and pillarNavGuard tests (and N8's `studioPaletteModel-36900.test.ts` shapes).
S1 (should-fix) — the deleted `accessTabs-12456` was not pillar-only: it pinned matrix behaviour that still runs on the new page (five tabs and sections, facet panels mounted for the Save gate, the bulk strip with keyboard focus, the CRUD bulk write, the sharing chip and object count). Move those cases into `StudioPermissionSetPage.fullScreen-36905.test.tsx`; correct the body's "served only the pillar".
S2 (should-fix) — three discard cases from the deleted `accessCreateTaken-26836` were not moved: a declined confirm discards nothing; a never-published set returns to the list; a read-only package shows no discard. Add them to the page test.
S3 (should-fix) — the list row's "New similar" (card item 2, `ResourceListPage.tsx`) has no test: one real `MetadataResourceListPage` case — base row, pair row, where the copy opens, no-package answer, writable-package CONTROL.

Nits: N1 `PermissionMatrixEditor`'s non-frame Studio header branch has no host — delete or note for #36909, and doc comments still name the Access pillar; N2 assert a direct child of the action group (`StudioItemHeader.statusPlace-12524`); N3 query the create button by test id (`metadataAreaHost.scope-28561`); N4 `accessPairCopy-29674`'s docstring claims a list-mark half it no longer asserts; N5 `/permission/new` reads as item `permission:new` in the copilot context; N6 a failed sets read makes a published set count as never published (discard would navigate to the list); N7 the console gate test should list `/studio/<pkg>/owd`; N9 the body says #36660 stays open for hooks, added actions and sharing-overview rows; N10 `permissionNewSimilar.tsx` header still says "shared with the pillar".

Brief: add the two items above (no published string removed; merged with #37108) and that the browser Back button is not guarded. Landing K: 14. Delta L1 on the new head, then the hand-off.
